calibration.label: RCP historical generic-ballot archive, 2004–2024
calibration.note: The live-source filter changes the current input. Historical filters use the supplied RCP generic-ballot archives for presidential, midterm, overall, low-turnout midterm, and high-turnout midterm comparisons.

sources.name: VoteHub
sources.note: Uses VoteHub's public published average when readable. If that page changes, it falls back to a clearly labeled VoteHub-API-derived blend from VoteHub's free raw-poll API.

sources.name: HillCast
sources.note: Automatically reads HillCast's published generic-ballot net margin. It is treated as margin-only when the article does not expose Democratic and Republican support shares.

sources.name: America First Insight
sources.note: Attempts to read AFI's public generic-ballot dashboard. Because the current chart is client-rendered, repository variables can provide the displayed topline when static fetching cannot see it.
sources.message: fetch failed; AFI public page did not expose a parsable topline; set AFI_GENERIC_DEM/AFI_GENERIC_REP or AFI_GENERIC_MARGIN in GitHub Actions variables
